notes: Entertainment: the author says outright this is a showcase, and the genre note covers exactly this case — a modelled vehicle where the subject is an object rather than a place. Stage B answers yes to 'is there a space' and no to 'does anyone walk through it', because the author confirmed it is viewed from outside only with no deck access and no interior, so SET rides alongside P0 and set-display is the shape that says the same thing on the shape axis. Display Piece is the preset for vehicle and model showcases: the hull is the hero build, the composed viewpoints are how a 500-stud liner is actually looked at, and zone-graphics carries the 'detailed' request as isolated detail clusters. Nothing here needs P3 — the interior is explicitly deferred — and the request for separate Parts per major section is a build-organisation instruction with no layout option, so it is passed through as a note rather than a pick.
